messages:
sam_sales: Quick sync — VoltEdge sent back MSA/DPA redlines and procurement says they will only issue a PO prior to countersigning the Order Form. Asks: Net45, PO must reference OF#, expanded auditor rights, and HSM language. POC onboarding blocked until PO.

jen_ops: If we provision on PO-only what guardrails do we need? ops would need an explicit PO PDF + billing contact + an ack to a short provisional addendum.

carmen_legal: I reviewed their redlines. They broaden audit access and added HSM indemnities. We should not accept unlimited auditor access. Propose a 30-day "Provisional Access Addendum": scope audits to portal log extracts, cap liability to trial credit, and automatic expiry if MSA unsigned. I'll draft a narrow addendum today.

paul_fin: Finance can accept PO as a trigger provided the PO references the Order Form and contains billing entity + tax id. Otherwise require a small prepay or trial credit cap. Net45 OK after entity validation. Ask customer to send PO PDF to billing@redwood.com.

neha_sec: Security: SOC2 Type II summary ready. We don't publish an HSM attestation today; HSM available on Private deployment (~2-3w). For POC: disable exports, retention=14d, named-access only. That should mitigate audit surface.

matt_se: For POC perf we can do a Dedicated sandbox with KMS placeholder. ETA ~5 business days after PO + billing + addendum ack. Note: HSM adds latency; recommend `batch_size:16` and `cache:prefix` for cost/perf balance.

sam_sales: Customer claims PO will be sent today and will reference OF-VE-113. Will they accept the provisional addendum? They indicated yes if we provide concise language.

carmen_legal: I'll upload the addendum redline and an Exhibit A ops checklist (retention, exports, roles). Keep it single page so customers sign quickly.

paul_fin: Once PO PDF arrives, send to billing@redwood.com and cc finance. We'll validate entity and tax/VAT. If anything missing we'll request the info and hold provisioning.

jen_ops: Ops will reserve an infra slot. Provisioning steps: 1) confirm PO + billing + addendum ack, 2) spin sandbox, 3) enforce retention and export settings. ETA 5bd.

sam_sales: Action list: Carmen -> addendum redline by EOD; Paul -> billing template and validation checklist; Neha -> SOC2 summary + HSM note; Matt -> confirm infra slot; Jen -> ops checklist. I'll push customer for PO PDF and billing contact now.

sam_sales: Customer just uploaded PO snippet in chat: "PO# VE-2026-555, Net45, Bill to Redwood Inference Inc, Ref: OF-VE-113". Asking them to attach PDF and billing email.

paul_fin: Thanks — once we have PO PDF we'll start entity validation. If international, include VAT number.

carmen_legal: If customer tries to expand audit scope we will push back and require GC approval. Provisional addendum keeps things tight.

sam_sales: Will post PO PDF when it lands. If they countersign the addendum we can move forward with provisioning. :thumbsup:
